repository.name: @webex/plugin-encryption
repository.purpose: Public Webex JS SDK plugin registered as webex.cypher that downloads and decrypts encrypted Webex files. downloadAndDecryptFile reads the KMS key URI and the JWE-encrypted SCR from the keyUri and JWE query parameters of the file URL, or from the options, asks webex.internal.encryption to decrypt the SCR with the KMS key, and returns the internal download of the file decrypted with that SCR, either directly from the URL (the default) or through the Webex files service. register and deregister register the SDK device with WDM through webex.internal.device and track the result in a registered flag. The package main, src/webex.js, is a small CommonJS Webex constructor that loads only the authorization, internal encryption, and cypher plugins; the workspace also builds it as the UMD encryption bundle.

plugin-encryption-sdk.summary: Published npm package @webex/plugin-encryption. main and exports['.'] are dist/webex.js (src/webex.js), whose CommonJS export is a Webex constructor with Webex.init(attrs); devMain is src/index.ts and types is dist/types/index.d.ts, which declares the default export Cypher and the types FileDownloadOptions and IEncryption, so the declared default does not match the runtime main. Importing src/index.ts registers public plugin cypher with config {cypher: {}}. webex.cypher exposes register(), deregister(), downloadAndDecryptFile(fileUri, {useFileService, keyUri, jwe}), and the public registered flag. Specified in src/docs/README.md.

encryption-umd-entry.summary: The workspace webpack.config.js builds its UMD entry encryption, library name Webex, from this file; the webex package ships it as umd/encryption.min.js (webex module spec MOD-019 names this package as the owner of its behavior). It requires the polyfill when needed, @webex/plugin-authorization, @webex/internal-plugin-encryption, and ./index, then extends WebexCore with version PACKAGE_VERSION.

encrypted-attachment-url.summary: An encrypted attachment URL is an absolute https file URL whose case-sensitive query parameters keyUri (the KMS key URI) and JWE (the compact JWE of the file SCR) carry the decryption inputs. downloadAndDecryptFile reads both with URLSearchParams.get, and GETs the whole URL, query included, through webex.internal.encryption.download.

internal-plugin-encryption-sdk.source: @webex/internal-plugin-encryption (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-encryption/src/docs/README.md MOD-007, MOD-009, MOD-010)
internal-plugin-encryption-sdk.summary: webex.internal.encryption.decryptScr(key, cipherScr) resolves the key through getKey (key cache, then KMS) and resolves SCR.fromJWE. download(fileUrl, scr, options) rejects without both arguments, defaults useFileService to true, rejects a direct URL that does not start with https:// when useFileService is false, otherwise looks up the download URL with POST /v1/download/endpoints and falls back to the original URL, GETs the bytes, emits progress events on its returned promise, and resolves decryptBinary(scr, body).

internal-plugin-device-registration.source: @webex/internal-plugin-device (workspace package, not declared in package.json; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-device/src/docs/README.md MOD-001, MOD-005, MOD-011)
internal-plugin-device-registration.summary: webex.internal.device.register() registers with WDM, or refreshes when already registered; unregister() resolves at once when unregistered, otherwise DELETEs the device and clears local state, and a 404 clears local state but still rejects. The device plugin's onBeforeLogout hook calls unregister().

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module spec consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md MOD-008, MOD-009, MOD-013, MOD-044)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin(name, ctor, {config}) returns without change when the name is already registered unless replace is set, and merges config into the default config; WebexPlugin.config reads the lowercased namespace key of webex.config; the default config uses memory storage adapters; WebexCore.extend builds a constructor whose instances carry the public plugins registered before it; MemoryStoreAdapter is re-exported.

plugin-authorization-entry.summary: Importing the package loads the Node or browser authorization plugin, chosen by its browser field; each imports @webex/internal-plugin-device and registers public plugin authorization.
